orchestrator.description: Coordinates project workflow. Delegates to specialized subagents like backend-dev, devops, tester, reviewer, debugger, docs-writer, pr-generator, and evaluator. Manages task assignment, progress tracking, and integration of subagent outputs. Ensures cohesive project development and delivery.

task-planner.description: Breaks large tasks into structured, step-by-step plans before implementation begins.

backend-dev.description: Handles backend services, database architecture, and backend performance optimization. Uses senior-architect and database-schema-designer skills for complex backend design. Invokes senior-security skill for security best practices in backend development. supabase-postgres-best-practices skill is used for Postgres database design and optimization in Supabase, api-integration-specialist skill is used for integrating third-party APIs with proper authentication, error handling, and rate limiting, clean-code-specialist skill is used to ensure code quality and maintainability in backend development, and code-review skill is used to review backend code for quality, security vulnerabilities, and best practices, code-review skill is used to review backend code for quality, security vulnerabilities, and best practices, systematic-debugging skill is used to identify and fix bugs in backend code, uses python-patterns skill to implement common design patterns in Python for backend development.

devops.description: Manages deployment, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure monitoring. Uses senior-devops skill for DevOps practices and automation. Invokes senior-security skill for secure deployment and infrastructure management, clean-code-specialist skill is used to ensure code quality and maintainability in DevOps scripts and configurations, and code-review skill is used to review DevOps code for quality, security vulnerabilities, and best practices.

tester.description: Runs automated and manual tests, writes test cases and coverage reports.

reviewer.description: Reviews code for quality, security vulnerabilities, and best practices.Uses code-review skill to perform comprehensive code reviews, providing feedback on code quality, security vulnerabilities, and adherence to best practices. Invokes clean-code-specialist skill to ensure code maintainability and readability during the review process.

debugger.description: Debugs runtime issues, traces errors, and proposes fixes.

pr-generator.description: Generates pull request descriptions, changelogs, and commit summaries.

evaluator.description: Evaluates outputs for correctness, completeness, and quality.

github-publisher.description: Creates a new GitHub repository, generates a professional README and documentation, writes a structured commit message, and pushes the entire project. Invoke when the user wants to publish a local project to GitHub for the first time.
